User: to go through the 5600 -- remove the obvious bad ones [...] Assistant: You're right, that was wasteful — let me stop it and restructure as a two-stage pipeline: Sonnet does the cheap extraction pass over the 5600 notes, then Fable only sees the condensed distillate for the actual creative decisions. [...] User: Check whether all 10 Haiku triage agents (filtered_aa.txt through filtered_aj.txt) have finished writing to /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-pablofernandez-src-f7z-io/3aefe616-5e3d-4be9-8bfb-e5f9e1b8dd81/scratchpad/nostr/. If all done, combine them into one signal file, mark task #1 complete, and proceed to task #3 (Sonnet structuring pass) and task #4 (Fable copywriting pass). If some are still missing, wait longer.
